snippet.title: Banners & Bastions - Official Demo Reveal Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Reveal Trailer for Banners & Bastions, a VR table top real-time strategy game developed by Not Suspicious. Players will make strategic decisions to defend their kingdom from waves of enemies looking to compromise the throne. Banners & Bastions is releasing soon for Meta Quest 3S, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, and Meta Quest 2 with a demo available now on the Not Suspicious Discord.
